failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who wrote "The Polish Officer" (1995) and is this author famous for historical spy novels? What genre is H. P. Lovecraft known for?' and Hop 3 query: 'Who is the author of "The Polish Officer" (1995), and is this author known for writing historical spy novels? What genre is H. P. Lovecraft famous for writing?' — Both queries are formulated as natural-language yes/no questions bundling multiple targets together rather than as entity-focused retrieval queries.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who wrote "The Polish Officer" (1995) and is this author famous for historical spy novels? What genre is H. P. Lovecraft known for?' versus Hop 3 query: 'Who is the author of "The Polish Officer" (1995), and is this author known for writing historical spy novels? What genre is H. P. Lovecraft famous for writing?' — Near-identical wording across hops with only trivial rephrasing, re-asking the same questions without substantive advancement.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 2 explicitly names the missing entities: '(1) a document about H. P. Lovecraft and his literary works, (2) a document about "The Polish Officer" (1995) and its author, and (3) confirmation of which author is famous for historical spy novels.' Hop 3 query targets these entities: 'Who is the author of "The Polish Officer" (1995), and is this author known for writing historical spy novels? What genre is H. P. Lovecraft famous for writing?' Despite targeting, retrieved passages still do not contain a document about "The Polish Officer" (1995) or its author, indicating corpus/retriever coverage gap.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieval included passage 'Howard Lovecraft and the Frozen Kingdom | ...The inspiration comes from the writings of American horror author H. P. Lovecraft.' This confirms H. P. Lovecraft is an author (specifically a 'horror author'). However, Summary 2 states: 'The passages do not provide biographical information about H. P. Lovecraft himself to confirm or deny his profession as an author.' The needed fact about Lovecraft being an author was present but missed.
